decisions.decision: Audit cascade shipped as 3 separate PRs (security/validation/verification) rather than one bundle
decisions.rationale: Operator's option-2 decision at the prior context-warning checkpoint. Each audit gets its own short-lived branch + PR; lower review fatigue than bundling. Matches PR #4/#6 state-bookkeeping precedent.

decisions.decision: Option B surgical revert pattern for CR auto-fix over-scope
decisions.rationale: CR's auto-apply on PR #8 ran pnpm install as a side-effect, bumping ~30 unrelated transitive deps + resurrecting a deleted CardAction component. Three options: (A) git reset --hard + force-push, (B) additive revert commit restoring just the unwanted files, (C) merge as-is. Chose B — surgical (preserves CR's legitimate STATE.md path-redaction), no force-push, history preserved, additive. Documented in PR #8 commit `062f341`.

decisions.decision: ADR-028 bundle: PolicyId brand + UserNotProvisionedError subCode + info-disclosure boundary in single PR
decisions.rationale: Operator explicit choice. Three concerns share scope (type-safety for the policy domain) and are independently small but conceptually adjacent. Splitting into 3 PRs adds review overhead for little benefit.

decisions.decision: PolicyId branded; UserId/OrgId NOT branded yet (slippery-slope policy)
decisions.rationale: PolicyId threaded through 7 transition orchestrators + 5 repository methods + 7 Server Actions — highest cross-confusion risk. UserId/OrgId mostly stay inside OrgContext/OrgScope — well-contained. Brand coverage is opportunistic; future PRs touching User/Org-heavy code MAY brand if friction warrants.

decisions.decision: UserNotProvisionedError.subCode is REQUIRED parameter (not optional with default)
decisions.rationale: Optional with default would let new throw sites silently ship without discriminating — exactly the 'distinction without behavioral difference' failure mode ADR-027 worried about. Required parameter forces every author to make the discrimination call explicit at the throw point. Mechanical update for existing tests.
TS compiler already rejects callers that pass `string` where `PolicyId` is expected. Gate value is signature-drift prevention. Matches check-error-discipline.ts discipline.

decisions.decision: Tenant-isolation predicate added to 6 direct policies updates in transitions.ts
decisions.rationale: CR PR #13 outside-diff finding surfaced a CLAUDE.md ALWAYS-rule violation: every DB query MUST include org_id. The 6 .update(policies).where(eq(policies.id, ...)) calls in transitions.ts only filtered by id. Defense-in-depth held at runtime (RLS + Policies.findById did filter by org_id), but app-layer predicate was missing. Now: and(eq(policies.orgId, s.orgId), eq(policies.id, policyId)) at all 6 sites.
